id: 04_EquiTips RegO SK Series Cryogenic Globe Valves Explained
title: 低温截止阀解析
source_doc: course/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/04_EquiTips RegO SK Series Cryogenic Globe Valves Explained.md
author_source: project/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/04_EquiTips RegO SK Series Cryogenic Globe Valves Explained/src.py

points.K1: 低温截止阀是液氮、液氧、液氩等低温储罐和管路上用来开关、调节液体或气体的阀门，专门工厂制造
points.K2: 低温阀门有多种口径和端部连接方式，要按管路选用
points.K3: 填料（阀杆密封）在低温下容易收缩泄漏，弹簧加载的冷密封填料能自动补偿，保持密封
points.K4: 锥形阀座等设计减少维护、减少停机
points.K5: 阀门需要维护；结构简单、便于拆装的阀座可以让维修更快、更少出错
points.K6: 手轮要便于操作人员转动，避免用力过猛或借助加力工具
points.K7: 阀门应通过正规渠道采购

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜站在阀门厂车间的货架前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing safety glasses stands in front of shelves in a valve factory workshop and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到设备小课堂，今天在阀门厂。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 小研戴着护目镜走进画面，和欣欣并肩站立
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing safety glasses walks into the frame and stands beside the panda mascot.
shots.narration: 嘉宾小研，是厂家的产品管理总监。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰站在一个白色低温储罐下，看着管路上的蓝色手轮阀门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands below a white cryogenic storage tank, looking up at blue handwheel valves on its piping.
shots.narration: 阿杰常看见储罐管路上的蓝手轮阀门。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark above him.
shots.narration: 这些阀门有什么门道？一起来听听。

shots.section_title: 低温截止阀是液氮、液氧、液氩等低温储罐和管路上用来开关、调节液体或气体的阀门，专门工厂制造
shots.scene: 小研指向身后车间，旁边浮现三个工厂图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points to the workshop behind her, with three small factory icons floating beside her.
shots.narration: 小研说，他们有三处低温产品工厂。

shots.section_title: 低温截止阀是液氮、液氧、液氩等低温储罐和管路上用来开关、调节液体或气体的阀门，专门工厂制造
shots.scene: 欣欣双手举起一只蓝色手轮的不锈钢截止阀
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a stainless steel globe valve with a blue handwheel in both hands.
shots.narration: 欣欣手里这只，就是低温截止阀。

shots.section_title: 低温截止阀是液氮、液氧、液氩等低温储罐和管路上用来开关、调节液体或气体的阀门，专门工厂制造
shots.scene: 低温储罐和管路示意图，截止阀装在出液管上
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cryogenic storage tank and its piping, with globe valves on the liquid and gas lines. No people.
shots.narration: 用在液氮、液氧、液氩储罐和管路上。

shots.section_title: 低温截止阀是液氮、液氧、液氩等低温储罐和管路上用来开关、调节液体或气体的阀门，专门工厂制造
shots.scene: 阀门打开和关闭两个状态的图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons of the same valve, one open with flow arrows and one closed with no flow. No people.
shots.narration: 用来开关和调节液体或气体。

shots.section_title: 低温截止阀是液氮、液氧、液氩等低温储罐和管路上用来开关、调节液体或气体的阀门，专门工厂制造
shots.scene: 小研竖起大拇指，阀门旁浮现一枚奖章图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gives a thumbs up, with a medal icon floating next to the valve.
shots.narration: 她说这个系列是市场上最好的。

shots.section_title: 低温阀门有多种口径和端部连接方式，要按管路选用
shots.scene: 日历图标翻过十几页
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon flipping through more than ten pages. No people.
shots.narration: 这个系列已经做了十多年。

shots.section_title: 低温阀门有多种口径和端部连接方式，要按管路选用
shots.scene: 从小到大一排截止阀，最大的标着三英寸
shots.prompt_en: A row of globe valves from small to large, the largest marked with a size arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 现在新增了大口径，最大到三英寸。

shots.section_title: 低温阀门有多种口径和端部连接方式，要按管路选用
shots.scene: 焊接、螺纹、法兰三种端部连接图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons of valve end connections: a welded end, a threaded end and a flanged end. No people.
shots.narration: 还有不同的端部连接方式可选。

shots.section_title: 填料（阀杆密封）在低温下容易收缩泄漏，弹簧加载的冷密封填料能自动补偿，保持密封
shots.scene: 装配线上戴蓝手套的手在夹具上组装一排阀体
shots.prompt_en: On an assembly line, hands in blue gloves assemble a row of brass valve bodies on fixtures, with a red parts bag nearby.
shots.narration: 第一个优点：弹簧加载的冷密封填料。
overlay: 弹簧加载的冷密封填料

shots.section_title: 填料（阀杆密封）在低温下容易收缩泄漏，弹簧加载的冷密封填料能自动补偿，保持密封
shots.scene: 阀杆填料剖面示意：低温收缩，弹簧把填料压紧
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a valve stem packing: packing shrinks in the cold and a spring pushes it tight again. No people.
shots.narration: 低温下填料收缩，弹簧会把它压紧。

shots.section_title: 锥形阀座等设计减少维护、减少停机
shots.scene: 锥形阀座剖面示意，阀芯严丝合缝落在锥面上
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a conical valve seat with the plug fitting snugly into the cone. No people.
shots.narration: 第二个优点：锥形阀座设计。

shots.section_title: 锥形阀座等设计减少维护、减少停机
shots.scene: 扳手图标变小，时钟图标变大
shots.prompt_en: A wrench icon shrinking while a running clock icon grows larger. No people.
shots.narration: 维护少了，运行时间就长了。

shots.section_title: 阀门需要维护；结构简单、便于拆装的阀座可以让维修更快、更少出错
shots.scene: 老李在工作台上拆开一只截止阀，取出阀座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a globe valve on a workbench and lifts out its seat in one piece.
shots.narration: 真要维护时，一体式阀座拆装方便。

shots.section_title: 阀门需要维护；结构简单、便于拆装的阀座可以让维修更快、更少出错
shots.scene: 秒表图标和一个整块阀座图标
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon next to a one-piece valve seat icon. No people.
shots.narration: 维修又简单又快。

shots.section_title: 手轮要便于操作人员转动，避免用力过猛或借助加力工具
shots.scene: 老李在储罐旁轻松转动蓝色手轮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer easily turns a blue handwheel on a valve beside a cryogenic tank.
shots.narration: 第三个优点：人体工学手轮。
overlay: 手轮便于操作人员转动

shots.section_title: 手轮要便于操作人员转动，避免用力过猛或借助加力工具
shots.scene: 手轮特写，握把弧度贴合手掌
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an ergonomic handwheel with grips shaped to fit a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 现场操作人员转起来很轻松。

shots.section_title: 阀门应通过正规渠道采购
shots.scene: 欣欣问去哪里买，小研指向一个空白经销商标牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot asks where to buy, and the female graduate student points to a blank distributor sign.
shots.narration: 去哪里买？找当地的经销商。

shots.section_title: 阀门应通过正规渠道采购
shots.scene: 电话图标和空白号码条
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a blank number bar. No people.
shots.narration: 欣欣报出了经销商的订购电话。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 截止阀、口径、连接方式三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a globe valve, a size arrow and three end connection types.
shots.narration: 低温截止阀，口径连接多样可选。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 填料弹簧、锥形阀座、一体阀座、手轮四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a spring-loaded packing, a conical seat, a one-piece seat and an ergonomic handwheel. No people.
shots.narration: 冷密封填料、锥形阀座、好拆、好转。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和小研戴着护目镜在车间里挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the female graduate student, both wearing safety glasses, wave goodbye in the workshop.
shots.narration: 今天的设备小课堂就到这里，下次见！
